# Overview

This vignette will demonstrate the longitudinal Phoenix workflow for EHR or
event-level data:

```r
# prepare_*() inputs -> prepare_phoenix_data() -> score_prepared_phoenix_data()
```

It will cover input preparation, encounter identifiers and clocks, look-back
rules, suspected-infection inputs, scoring windows, aggregation choices, and
interpretation of the resulting organ dysfunction and Phoenix Sepsis scores.

# Current guidance

Until this vignette is complete, consult the package help for
`prepare_inputs_range()`, `prepare_inputs_discrete()`,
`prepare_phoenix_data()`, and `score_prepared_phoenix_data()`. The existing
`vignette("phoenix", package = "phoenix")` covers applying the Phoenix rubric
to already prepared, row-level data.
